description: List DEV.to tags. Uses the public Forem API by default and falls back to the /tags page when the API fails. Provide --query to search tags by name (uses the page search directly because the API does not support tag search). Returns tag name, summary, display colors, and posts count when available.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of tags to return (integer, 1–1000, default 50).

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Filter tags by name substring, e.g. '{query}'. When provided, the command uses the /tags page search because the Forem API does not support server-side tag search.
